review:
A medieval 25-liner where shields are both scatters and coins. Scatters start free spins; coins feed a Hold and Win with three jackpot levels.

In free spins, reels 2, 3 and 4 merge into one giant 3x3 symbol that pays as if nine of it had landed – that's the moment you're waiting for. The coin bonus can award the Mini, Major or Mega jackpot. Medium-high volatility, 2,000x max, 95.24% RTP. Close cousin of God of Wealth Hold And Win.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
